Name: (CP) Pink Bear Obelisks
Author: OceanLaboratory
Description:
This is my attempt at creating a mod for Content Patcher that replaces the obelisks with cuter versions that share a similar color palette to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499]Cute Valley - Pink[/url] by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/36871425]Rosiea[/url]. There aren't a lot of mods for obelisks, especially ones that fit my aesthetic, so I decided to take matters into my own hands :) Color palette is inspired by Cute Valley but all assets are my own.

Just drop the folder directly into your mods folder and that's it!
